title: Half man, half fish
textBlocks: The Story of the Stolen Ark

Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story, 
you will hear what happened to the 
stolen Ark!

The people who stolen it, the Philistines, didn’t worship the one true God.
They worshipped a false god called Dagon.

Dagon was a statue. Half man and half fish.

The Philistines put the Ark in Dagon’s Temple
AND GUESS WHAT HAPPENED NEXT!

Dagon fell and his head broke and so did his hands.
This showed the Philistine’s that the God of Israel was the one true God
